source.source_book_identity: Not identified in the attachment; source_pages are retained as owner-supplied page references, not independently verified citations.
source.approval_scope: Merge every supplied racial tradition and name into the Armageddon package, including standalone traditions without a playable race; implement element descriptions and reasonable design choices.

transfer_recovery.reason: The task's compact JSON transfer was truncated inside Labyrinth. Complete display forms and all 78 descriptions were recovered read-only from the explicitly supplied approved Page; compact defaults, component semantics and source provenance come from the complete portions of that transfer.
transfer_recovery.original_file_sha256_status: Provided by upstream approved audit; raw Library file was unavailable to this task and its bytes were not independently rehashed.

merge_policy.spelling: Preserve exact Unicode, case, apostrophes, hyphens and spaces from display. No transliteration or autocorrection.
merge_policy.deduplication: Exact duplicate display within the same semantic pool and source gender is stored once. Do not conflate near matches, cross-element identities or names from different cultures. Inherited Human pools use references instead of duplicate weights.
merge_policy.canonical_status: Approved package adaptations, not a claim of historical Armageddon canon. Pattern descriptions are observations and design guidance, not hard validators.
merge_policy.additional_customs: No compulsory focus-name ceremony, rite-of-passage renaming, social exclusion, slavery, or occupational renaming is adopted. The Elf verified-member tribal display and Pterran earned path prefix are the narrowly adopted supplied component rules.

random_profile_defaults.gender_selection_policy: male: male + shared; female: female + shared; all other or unspecified genders: union of all entries. If a gendered subset is empty, use shared, then union. Source labels are preferences only and free entry is not constrained.
random_profile_defaults.weight_policy: uniform weight 1 per exact eligible display form; inherited pools referenced, not concatenated
random_profile_defaults.full_display_policy: Only explicit eligible optional components may be added. A confirmed Pterran path prefixes; an explicitly selected background-supported family name follows; an Elf tribal surname follows only when its display flag and confirmed membership are set. Do not implicitly join every component.

reference_only.policy: None of these strings is imported into personal-name random pools. House and tribal identifiers remain documentary references, not seeded memberships or generic surnames.
reference_only.approval_precedence: Every personal-name entry in the new owner-supplied file is approved, including source examples and conspicuous fictional-name collisions. The earlier strictly-original recommendation is superseded for this imported pool. Keep provenance and any editorial collision warnings, but do not silently remove or blacklist approved imports; this does not import their fictional biographies or affiliations.

personal_entry_defaults.provenance_rule: Indices are zero-based positions in the corresponding gender array. Listed indices are owner-supplied creative additions; all remaining entries are owner-supplied source or revised examples. All entries are approved with weight 1.

culture_defaults.racial_tradition_summary: Approved owner-supplied naming tradition; available independently of any playable race.

transfer_expansion_rule: Apply personal_entry_defaults to every pool entry, culture_defaults to each culture, culture_element_defaults to each element, and random_profile_defaults under each random_profile_id; explicit values override defaults. Descriptions remain verbatim.
